```python
from flask import Flask, request
from twilio.twiml.voice_response import VoiceResponse
import requests

app = Flask(__name__)

@app.route("/weather", methods=["POST"])
def get_weather():
    zip_code = request.values.get("zip_code")
    api_key = "YOUR_OPENWEATHERMAP_API_KEY"
    base_url = f"http://api.openweathermap.org/data/2.5/weather?zip={zip_code}&appid={api_key}"
    response = requests.get(base_url)
    weather_data = response.json()
    current_weather = weather_data["weather"][0]["description"]
    
    twiml = VoiceResponse()
    twiml.say(f"The current weather in {zip_code} is {current_weather}")
    return str(twiml)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    app.run(debug=True)
```
